verdict.rationale: ELSTER is a tax e-filing platform with a sanctioned third-party software channel, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only says that other tax software supporting ELSTER can transmit through it. Nothing in the pack documents API versioning, version lifecycles or a deprecation policy, and the ERiC host probe concerns availability, not versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
